name: Magic Connoisseur

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: A level 1 and a level 2 spell from your Magic Initiate list, always prepared, each cast once free per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Additional Spells
benefits.summary: A level 1 and a level 2 spell from your Magic Initiate list, always prepared, each cast once free per Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell from the spell list of your Magic Initiate feat; they use that feat's spellcasting ability. You always have both prepared, can cast each once without a slot (regaining that on a Long Rest), and can cast them with your slots. When you gain a level you can swap one for another of the same level from that list.
